name: After § 132
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 132a. Strongly condemns the intention of some Member States to withdraw from the 1997 Convention on the Prohibition of the Use, Stockpiling, Production and Transfer of Anti-Personnel Mines and on their Destruction (Ottawa Convention) and the Convention on Cluster Munitions (Oslo Convention) in order to start stockpiling and using anti-personnel landmines and cluster munitions; rejects the assumption that the current geopolitical situation justifies the deployment of such weapons, which have devastating humanitarian consequences for the civilian population, especially for minors; calls on the Commission and the Council to request that Member States abide by their obligations under international and humanitarian law and abstain from any such initiatives;
